packages.name: systematic-investment-research-reviewer
packages.method: Check within-split date order; require train labels to end strictly before validation with the declared gap, and validation to end before test with the same gap. Future test completion, features available after use, holdout reuse and trials beyond the supplied limit remain explicit findings. Cost drag in basis points equals turnover fraction times one-way cost in basis points. It is a supplied-experiment cost diagnostic, not a computed or validated strategy return. No statistical significance, Sharpe ratio, portfolio simulation, multiple-testing probability or capacity estimate is invented.
packages.native_schema: experiments[]: experiment_id, source_ref; train_start, train_end, train_label_end, validation_start/end, test_start/end (dates); required_gap_days (nonnegative integer); trials_considered, predeclared_trial_limit, holdout_uses (positive integers); survivorship_control_reviewed (boolean or unknown); feature_availability[{feature_id,available_at,used_at,source_ref}]; turnover_definition=one_way_traded_notional_over_average_nav, turnover_fraction, one_way_cost_bps, reported_cost_drag_bps (optional). Turnover and cost cover exactly the supplied test period. Fraction 2 means 200 percent one-way turnover, not 2 percent.

primary_references.status: US agency investor advisory; accessed 2026-09-21. Hypothetical results have practical limitations; this package makes no registration or legal-applicability determination.

packages.name: private-investment-due-diligence-reviewer
packages.method: Sum eligible positive funding and uses separately; show funding minus uses only if complete. Simple primary common-equity post-money ownership equals investor contribution / (pre-money equity value + all new primary equity), with no secondary, preference, option or convertible modeling. For supplied scenarios compute net debt and positive-denominator net leverage/interest coverage. Diligence status is a supplied declaration; unfilled committee topics, open/contradicted evidence and missing financial inputs remain gaps. Ratios round explicitly to 12 places.
packages.native_schema: transaction: source_ref, security_type, secondary_purchase (boolean), pre_money_equity_value, new_primary_equity, investor_primary_amount, funding_sources[] and uses[] each {line_id,amount,currency,source_ref}. required_diligence_topics[] is the committee-owned required scope. diligence_evidence[{topic,status=supported|open|contradicted,source_ref}]. scenarios[{scenario_id,debt,cash,ebitda,cash_interest,source_ref}] use a common supplied period/basis; amounts may be null to retain missingness.

primary_references.title: IMF Global Financial Stability Report, April 2024
primary_references.status: Published 2024-04-16; global analytical research, not a binding transaction standard. Private-market leverage, valuation opacity and liquidity risks motivate the evidence scope; formulas are explicitly supplied analytical conventions.

packages.name: private-investment-monitor
packages.method: Use only observations inside the caller-supplied age window and no later than as_of. Compare like units. Minimum headroom=value-threshold; maximum headroom=threshold-value. Negative headroom creates a watch exception, not default. Prior change needs an earlier like-unit sourced observation. Cash runway=cash available / positive monthly net burn at 12 places. Nonpositive burn yields no finite runway. Observed chronology excludes future events.
packages.native_schema: maximum_observation_age_days (nonnegative integer). metrics[{metric_id,value,unit,observed_at,source_ref,threshold,threshold_unit,threshold_source_ref,direction=minimum|maximum,prior_value?,prior_unit?,prior_observed_at?,prior_source_ref?}]. liquidity{cash_available,monthly_net_cash_burn,observed_at,source_ref}. events[] optional: {event_id,event_date,event_type,source_ref}. Required metric/liquidity amounts may be null; no implied zero.

primary_references.title: IMF private-credit vulnerabilities research

packages.name: private-credit-investment-reviewer
packages.method: Net leverage=(debt-cash)/positive EBITDA; interest coverage=EBITDA/positive cash interest; DSCR=cash available for debt service/(cash interest+scheduled principal), with positive denominator. Definitions must match active supplied covenant terms. Exact cross-products determine threshold flags; displayed ratios/headroom round to 12 places. A threshold exception does not establish enforceable default or waiver. Maturity within the supplied day horizon requires refinancing review; balloon evidence remains supplied.
packages.native_schema: facility{facility_id,maturity_date,balloon_amount,source_ref}; maturity_watch_days (nonnegative integer). scenarios[{scenario_id,definition_id,debt,cash,ebitda,cash_interest,scheduled_principal,cash_available_for_debt_service,source_ref}]. covenants[{covenant_id,metric=net_leverage|interest_coverage|dscr,direction=minimum|maximum,threshold,definition_id,status=active,source_ref}]. All financial scenario figures share a period and reviewed definition_id; explicitly separate cash interest from PIK. Null figures remain unknown.

packages.name: private-fund-capital-activity-reviewer
packages.method: Closing unfunded=opening+explicit increases-explicit decreases. Track calls and distributions independently; net cash to LP=distributions-calls. Compare reported closing minus calculated closing; no silent balancing item. Calls cannot increase unfunded; distributions cannot reduce unfunded. Mixed/missing currency, future events, unavailable source or unknown amount withhold the complete rollforward; known cash subtotals remain explicitly partial. No implicit recallability from a distribution label.
packages.native_schema: lp_balances[{lp_id,opening_unfunded,reported_closing_unfunded,source_ref}]. events[{event_id,lp_id,event_date,type=call|distribution|commitment_change,amount,currency,unfunded_effect=increase|decrease|none,unfunded_amount,recallable (required boolean for distributions),source_ref}]. Amounts are nonnegative; commitment_change changes only unfunded (no cash). Distinct event/LP ids required. Distribution recallable=true requires a positive explicit reinstatement no greater than cash. A non-recallable distribution has zero reinstatement.

packages.name: private-capital-commitment-planner
packages.method: Cash closes at opening+distributions+other cash flow-calls. Unfunded closes at opening+new commitments+recallable reinstatement-calls. Liquidity headroom=cash-liquidity floor. New commitments create unfunded exposure rather than automatic cash movement. Negative cash headroom and calls beyond unfunded commitments are explicit scenario flags. Each supplied schedule remains an assumption; no economic growth, distribution timing, forecasting probability or probability-weighted recommendation is invented.
packages.native_schema: opening_balances{cash,unfunded,liquidity_floor,source_ref}; scenarios[{scenario_id,source_ref,periods[{period_end,new_commitments,calls,distributions,recallable_reinstatement,other_cash_flow,source_ref}]}]. Periods must increase strictly after as_of. Every scenario resets to the same opening balances. Calls/distributions/new commitments/reinstatements are nonnegative; other_cash_flow is signed. Recallable reinstatement cannot exceed distributions. Any unknown amount poisons all later balances in that scenario.

packages.name: private-fund-waterfall-reviewer
packages.method: Use an aggregate LP pool, without GP invested-capital participation. Tier1 pays min(cash, unreturned LP capital) to LPs. Tier2 pays min(remaining cash, supplied accrued preferred entitlement) to LPs. Tier3 pays carry_fraction of remaining cash to GP and the remainder to LPs. Sum tiers and verify distributable cash-LP total-GP total=0. Show capital/preference unpaid after the distribution. Preferred accrual is supplied, never inferred from elapsed time or a headline hurdle. Contract-specific state must already reflect prior distributions and be independently reviewed.
packages.native_schema: terms{contract_id,source_ref,waterfall_style=european_whole_fund,catch_up=false,preferred_method=supplied_accrued_entitlement,gp_capital_participation=false,interim_clawback=false,terms_reviewed=true,carry_fraction}. distribution_state{distributable_cash,unreturned_lp_capital,accrued_preferred_return,source_ref}. All amounts nonnegative; carry_fraction in [0,1]. Required supported feature flags are explicit booleans. Other feature values produce an engine gap and no distribution calculations. Null balances/terms remain unknown.

packages.method: Compare illiquid assets to assets times the explicit maximum fraction using exact multiplication; display illiquid fraction at 12 places.
